subject: Literature
title: The Odyssey and the Hero's Return
description: A quick win: understand The Odyssey and the Hero's Return.

hook.text: After winning the Trojan War, Odysseus spent ten years trying to sail home, facing monsters and gods.

buildup.text: Homer's Odyssey sent its hero past Cyclops, Sirens, and the underworld before he could reach his wife.

discovery.text: The poem invented the homecoming narrative: the idea that the journey back is harder than the journey out.

twist.text: When Odysseus finally returns, he must kill over a hundred men who have invaded his home and courted his wife.

climax.text: The Odyssey created the template for every quest-and-return story in Western literature and cinema.

punchline.text: Every road trip story started with one ancient sailor.

quiz.question: What narrative innovation did the Odyssey introduce?
options: The homecoming narrative, where the return is harder than the departure
